status: PROPOSAL ONLY: awaiting main approval; not frozen; generation 3 not built
mission: Find a weakly correlated counterexample whose premature third-order screening failure persists under a specified finite assay of uncertainty in every coefficient of the effective paired Hamiltonian.
qualitative_change: Expand uncertainty directions from 42 VV controls to all 100 coefficients of the same pair-conserving effective Hamiltonian. Retain the original 0.001 Eh radius and every nominal numeric target.
nominal_design_space: Keep the existing 42 adjustable symmetric VV hopping/density controls and the same original fixed center values for all other coefficients. Do not expose any previous privileged witness or search artifact.

model.matrix_structure: Real symmetric transfer and density matrices with exactly zero diagonals. Pair energies are separate diagonal one-pair coefficients.
model.scope: All effective-model coefficients, not all unrestricted molecular two-electron integrals or a claim of ab initio Coulomb representability.

proposed_assay.coordinate_distribution: Independently uniform on [theta-delta,theta+delta] intersected with the coefficient bound for every upper-triangle transfer and density coefficient; sample the interval itself, not clamp a uniform draw. Pair energies independently uniform on [epsilon-delta,epsilon+delta]. Mirror every off-diagonal entry exactly.
proposed_assay.centering: Each draw is centered on the submitted nominal Hamiltonian, never on earlier perturbations.
proposed_assay.reference_handling: Recompute the reference determinant energy and every subset energy for each perturbed Hamiltonian; keep the original occupied/virtual labels and pair count.
proposed_assay.physical_failures: Count as unsuccessful cases; do not reject and resample them.
proposed_assay.numerical_failures: Independently recompute every case and reject nonfinite or numerically unverified evaluations; never treat a numerical failure as a scientifically meaningful gate failure.
proposed_assay.seed_status: No generation-3 seeds drawn or frozen. If approved, commit fresh hidden directions before fresh launch, independent of every private challenge and previous training draw.
proposed_assay.public_diagnostics: Disclose the complete coefficient ordering, distribution, case definition, independent public training directions, and original zero baseline. Keep participant read-only and output at writable-root witness.json.

score_proposal.nominal_score: Unchanged original minimum of parent, tail and ratio factors, zero if nominal invalid.
score_proposal.passed: Nominal passes and at least 122 of 128 fully verified perturbed cases pass; completion/resource checks also required.

evidence.official_B2_successes: 128/128 under unchanged original VV-only assay; remains a solved B2 result

mechanism_controls.full_noise_with_OO_hopping_still_zero: 0/128; failure does not require activating previously zero OO transfers
mechanism_controls.one_percent_relative_OV_noise: 111/128; even a relative rather than absolute uncertainty diagnostic loses the 95 percent criterion

feasibility_status: OPEN: no center passing this proposed assay is known. The old champion's failure does not imply impossibility. No optimization of the proposed generation-3 target has been performed here.
why_not_larger_VV_radius: The larger-radius VV failures are documented stress results but are not the proposed ratchet. Same-radius uncertainty in formerly fixed coefficients is a substantive new robustness question.
claim_limits: Only the specified finite machine-checkable assay, not universal robustness, a population-level 95 percent guarantee, failure of the paper's claimed theorem, or invalidation of the original B2 witness.
approval_gate: Main must approve the scientific scope and open feasibility before any packet construction or freeze. Do not change targets in response to a later fresh outcome.
